name: Ring Orden — D — Verified Payment Event

parameters.content:
## Stripe signature boundary
Stripe sends its original raw body directly to /api/webhooks/stripe. The backend verifies HMAC, session ID, amount, currency and event idempotency before updating PAID. It can then emit this authenticated event. Do not point Stripe directly at this n8n webhook. Extend this flow with your merchant notification or accounting steps.
